comment: The price experiments this service runs on its own offers, started from these rows (src/book-handlers.mjs 'price-experiments'): a row the service's book does not hold yet is started as written the next time the book opens; from then on the book keeps it, and tool:run-price-experiments on the operator account settles, stops or changes it. Each row is one experiment in the one record shape (src/price-experiments.mjs save input): every person shown its `surface` sees one arm, the same one every time, by `weight`; an arm is an offer row in src/sales.json, served only once its payment link exists. Results (people shown each arm, people who paid, money per person shown) are on Funnels and /billing/plan. Like any small shop's offer tests, each arm differs from the plan it tests in one thing: the price, the margin on usage, or the button. An arm's label is what the person sees that the other arms do not: its price, its usage margin or its button.

experiments.label: Publishing site monthly price
experiments.optimizing_for: Money collected per person shown the publishing site in their first 90 days; how many still have a site at 90 days breaks ties.

experiments.label: Trillion plan: spot price, usage margin, first week and button
experiments.optimizing_for: Money collected per person shown the plan in their first 90 days, usage included.
